**(a) Finite-size-matched deformations** (progress/40 §5.2).
The pilot's only resolved signal (α₁ = −0.05, first spatial star × first
momentum star) reversed between 4×6 and 5×6 because the two meshes sample
the momentum form factor `F₁(k)` differently. Look for deformations whose
momentum dependence is sampled comparably on 4×6, 5×6 and the 27-site
cluster, e.g. momentum stars or combinations whose values on the three
meshes' k-points have matching moments. Your first job is to make the
finite-size spread of a deformation smaller than its effect.
